defects.defect: Vertical rhythm is inconsistent: title sits ~50px under the top bar but the gap between Play button and nav bar is ~90px, and the ladder-to-Play gap ~30px
defects.direction: Normalize gaps to one spacing scale so top bar→title→scene→ladder→Play→nav read as an even stack
defects.region: title vs top bar / scene, y≈220-390

defects.defect: The framed ladder is excessively tall for its sparse contents, leaving a large expanse of empty wood that reads unfinished.
defects.direction: Reduce the panel height to fit the current nodes, or populate it with a fuller visible progression.
defects.region: Level ladder panel, center

defects.defect: Ladder occupies only a narrow center strip; the wide dark plank areas flanking it are empty and read as unfinished
defects.direction: Fill flanking space with map decoration, side-path nodes, or props, or narrow the panel so the ladder fills it (Kingdom Rush maps wind nodes across the full width)
defects.region: level ladder panel, left and right thirds (~x40-280 and x430-680, y740-1140)

defects.defect: Ladder panel is a large mostly-empty wooden board; the level path occupies only a narrow central column with wide blank flanks and only three nodes, reading as unfinished placeholder space
defects.direction: Shrink the panel height or populate it with a winding path, decorations and more level nodes so the framed area feels authored like Kingdom Rush's level map
defects.region: level ladder panel, y≈740-1150

defects.defect: Name pills (Bastion, Ember, Sage) sit flush against the panel's bottom inner edge and are unevenly spaced (Bastion at x≈100, Ember x≈362, Sage x≈583), not matching the characters' horizontal centers
defects.direction: Add bottom padding inside the panel and center each pill under its character with even, symmetric spacing
defects.region: hero scene panel, hero name pills y≈690

defects.defect: Title wordmark optical center is slightly right of screen center and the purple magic glow crops at the top edge of its bounding area
defects.direction: Center the wordmark on the same vertical axis as the panels and give the glow enough headroom to render uncropped
defects.region: title lettering, y≈250-370

defects.defect: The empty gap is noticeably larger than the otherwise consistent vertical rhythm between sections.
defects.direction: Tighten this gap or rebalance the ladder/button area to match adjacent spacing.
defects.region: Between Play button and bottom navigation

defects.defect: Vertical margins are uneven: gap below the Play button and gap above the title are larger than the scene-to-ladder and ladder-to-Play gaps
defects.direction: Equalize the vertical rhythm between top bar, title, scene, ladder, Play button, and nav bar
defects.region: between Play button (~y1280) and framed nav bar (~y1340)

defects.defect: Active Home cell uses a lighter fill that extends to the frame's inner edge while the other three items have no cell backing, making the row look unevenly divided
defects.direction: Inset the active highlight symmetrically within the nav frame and keep all four tab cells the same width
defects.region: bottom nav bar, Home cell x≈35-195

defects.defect: Locked nodes are much smaller than the level-1 node and cluster in the upper half, leaving the lower half of the strip mostly bare track
defects.direction: Distribute nodes evenly along the track and reduce the size disparity so the ladder reads as a continuous progression
defects.region: ladder panel, two lock nodes (~x360, y785 and y915)

defects.defect: Horizontal insets differ per block: scene panel is inset ~24px, ladder panel ~28px, Play button ~40px, so left/right edges do not align down the screen
defects.direction: Use one shared content width and identical side margins for scene, ladder and Play button
defects.region: hero scene panel vs ladder panel and Play button, x≈24-698

defects.defect: The four chips are equal width but the content inside is not balanced — '10/10' nearly fills its chip while '50', '30', '30' leave large right-hand gaps
defects.direction: Center icon+value pairs within each chip or size chips to content so the row reads evenly weighted
defects.region: top bar resource chips, y≈120-180
